description.value: Ay Chihuahua is an authentic Mexican restaurant on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, serving traditional dishes including pozole soup, tacos, enchiladas, and chimichangas prepared with homemade sauces and fresh ingredients. The restaurant operates two Lower Mainland locations and offers both dine-in and takeout. Customer reviews consistently highlight the quality of the homemade recipes and the availability of gluten-free options.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 17m; stands (4 spaces) at 44m; stands (2 spaces) at 81m. Total: 12 spaces.
